chapters: The words of Yirmiyahu son of Chilkiyah, of the priests who were in Anatot in the land of Binyamin.
To whom the word of Havayah came in the days of Yoshiyahu son of Amon, king of Yehudah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

And he was in the days of Yehoyakim son of Yoshiyahu, king of Yehudah, until the end of eleven years of Tzidkiyahu son of Yoshiyahu, king of Yehudah, until the exile of Yerushalayim in the fifth month.
And the word of Havayah came to me, saying:
When I had not yet formed you in the womb, I knew you, and when you had not yet emerged from the womb, I had appointed you; a prophet to the nations I made you.
And I said, "Alas, O Havayah Elokim! Behold, I know not to speak for I am a youth.
And Havayah said to me; Say not, "I am a youth," for wherever I send you, you shall go, and whatever I command you, you shall speak.
Fear them not, for I am with you to save you, Havayah says.
And Havayah stretched out His hand and reached my mouth, and Havayah said to me; Behold, I have placed My words in your mouth.
Behold, I have appointed you this day over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to crush, and to destroy and to demolish, to build and to plant.
And the word of Havayah came to me, saying: What do you see, Yirmiyahu? And I said, "I see a rod of an almond tree."
And Havayah said to me; You have seen well, for I hasten My word to accomplish it.
And the word of Havayah came to me a second time, saying: What do you see? And I said, "I see a bubbling pot, whose foam is toward the north."
And Havayah said to me; From the north the misfortune will break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

For, behold I am summoning all the families of the kingdoms of the north, Havayah says, and they will come and place, each one his throne at the entrance of the gates of Yerushalayim and against all its walls around and against all the cities of Yehudah.
And I will utter My judgments against them concerning all their evil, that they left Me and offered up burnt-offerings to other gods and they prostrated themselves to the work of their hands.
And you shall gird your loins and arise and speak to them all that I command you; be not dismayed by them, lest I break you before them.

And I, behold I have made you today into a fortified city and into an iron pillar, and into copper walls against the entire land, against the kings of Yehudah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
And they shall fight against you but they shall not prevail against you, for I am with you Havayah says, to save you.
And the word of Havayah came to me, saying:

Go and call out in the ears of Yerushalayim, saying: so Havayah said: I remember to you the lovingkindness of your youth, the love of your nuptials, your following Me in the desert, in a land not sown.
Yisroel is holy to Havayah, the first of His grain; all who eat him shall be guilty, evil shall befall them, Havayah says.
Hearken to the word of Havayah, O house of Yackov, and all the families of the house of Yisroel.
So Havayah says: What wrong did your forefathers find in Me, that they distanced themselves from Me, and they went after futility and themselves became futile?

And they did not say, "Where is Havayah, Who brought us up from the land of Mitzrayim, Who led us in the desert, in a land of plains and pits, in a land of waste and darkness, in a land where no man had passed and where no man had dwelt.
And I brought you to a forest land to eat of its produce and its goodness, and you came and contaminated My land, and made My heritage an abomination.

The priests did not say, "Where is Havayah?" And those who hold onto the Torah did not know Me and the rulers rebelled against Me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed what does not avail.
Therefore, I will still contend with you, Havayah says, and with your children's children will I contend.
For pass over to the isles of the Kittim and see, and send to Keidar and consider diligently, and see whether there was any such thing,
Whether a nation exchanged a deity although they are not gods. Yet My nation exchanged their glory for what does not avail.
Oh heavens, be astonished about this, and storm, become very desolate, Havayah says.
For My people have committed two evils; they have forsaken Me, the spring of living waters, to dig for themselves cisterns, broken cisterns that do not hold water.
Is Yisroel a slave? Is he a home-born slave? Why has he become a prey?
Young lions roar over him: they have raised their voice, and they have made his land a desolation; his cities were burnt without an inhabitant.
Also the children of Nof and Tachpanches will break your crown.
Is not this caused to you by your forsaking Havayah your Elokim at the time He leads you by the way?
And now, what have you to do in the way of Mitzrayim to drink the water of the Shichor and what have you to do in the way of Ashur to drink the water of the river?

Your evil will chastise you, and your backslidings will reprove you, and you shall know and see that your forsaking Havayah your Elokim is evil and bitter, and fear of Me was not upon you, Havayah Elokim of Hosts says.
For of old I broke your yoke, I tore open your yoke-bands, and you said, "I will not transgress," but on every lofty hill and under every leafy tree, you recline as a harlot.
Yet I planted you a noble vine stock, throughout of right seed; now how have you turned yourself into a degenerate wild vine to Me?
For if you wash with natron and use much soap, your iniquity is stained before Me, Havayah Elokim says.
How do you say, "I have not been defiled; I have not gone after the Bealim"? See your way in the valley, know what you have done, like a swift young she-camel, clinging to her ways.

A wild donkey accustomed to the desert, that snuffs up the wind in her desire, her tendency like the sea creatures, who can hinder her? All who seek her will not weary; in her month they will find her.
Withhold your foot from going barefoot and your throat from thirst; but you said, "I despair. No, for I love strangers, and I will follow them."
As the shame of a thief when he is found out, so have the house of Yisroel been ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets.
They say to the wood, "You are my father," and to the stone, "You bore us," for they turned to Me their nape and not their face, and at the time of their misfortune they say, "Arise and save us. "
Now where are your gods that you have made for yourself; let them get up if they will save you at the time of your misfortune, for as many as your cities were your gods, O Yehudah.
Why should you strive with Me? All of you have rebelled against Me, Havayah says.
In vain have I smitten your children, they received no correction. Your sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion.
O generation, you see the word of Havayah. Was I a desert to Yisroel or a land of thick darkness? Why have My people said, "We have been separated; we will no longer come to You"?
Will a virgin forget her jewelry, a bride her ribbons? Yet My people have forgotten Me for countless days.
How you adorn your way to seek love! Verily, even to the most evil you accustomed your ways.
Also in your skirts is found the blood of the souls of the innocent poor; you did not find them breaking in, but for all these.
And you said, "But I am innocent, surely His wrath has gone away from me." Behold, I contend with you concerning because you say, "I have not sinned."
How you degrade yourself exceedingly to change your way! You shall also be ashamed through Mitzrayim as you were ashamed through Ashur.
Also from this one shall you go out with your hands on your head, for Havayah has despised those whom you trust, and you shall not prosper through them.

I have to say; If a man sends away his wife, and she goes away from him, and marries another man, may he return to her again? Will not the land become defiled? But you have played the harlot with many lovers, yet return to Me, Havayah says.

Lift up your eyes upon the rivulets and see, where have you not been lain with? By the roads you sat for them like an Aravi in the desert, and you defiled the land with your harlotries and with your evil.
And the rains were withheld, and there has been no latter rain, and you had a harlot's forehead; you refused to be ashamed.
Will you not from this time call me, "My Father, You the Master of my youth."
Will He bear a grudge forever? Will He keep it to eternity? Behold, you have spoken, and you have committed evil things, and you were able.

And Havayah said to me in the days of King Yoshiyahu: Have you seen what the backsliding Yisroel has done? She goes on every lofty mountain and under every leafy tree, and she played the harlot there.
And I said after she had done all these things: She shall return to Me. But she did not return. And her treacherous sister Yehudah saw it.

And I saw, because of all that backsliding Yisroel had committed adultery, I sent her away, and I gave her her bill of divorcement, yet treacherous Yehudah, her sister, did not fear, and she too went and played the harlot.
And it was through the lightness of her harlotry, that she polluted the land, and she committed adultery with the stones and the wood.
And yet for all this, her treacherous sister Yehudah did not return to Me with all her heart, but falsely, Havayah says.
And Havayah said to me; Backsliding Yisroel has proven herself more righteous than treacherous Yehudah.
Go and proclaim these words to the north, and say; Return, O backsliding Yisroel, Havayah says. I will not let My anger rest upon you, for I am pious, Havayah says; I will not bear a grudge forever.

Only acknowledge your iniquity, for you have rebelled against Havayah your Elokim, and you have scattered your ways to strangers under every leafy tree, and you did not hearken to My voice, Havayah says.
Return, backsliding children, Havayah says, for I possessed you, and I will take you, one from a city and two from a family, and I will bring you to Tziyon.
And I will give you shepherds according to My heart, and they will feed you with knowledge and understanding.

And it shall be, when you multiply and are fruitful in the land in those days, Havayah says, they will no longer say, "The ark of Havayah's covenant," neither shall it come to mind, neither shall they mention it, nor shall they remember it, nor shall it be done anymore.

At that time, they will call Yerushalayim The Throne of Havayah, and all nations shall gather to it in the name of Havayah, to Yerushalayim, and they shall no longer follow the idea of their evil heart.
In those days, the house of Yehudah will go with the house of Yisroel, and they will come together from the north land to the land that I caused your forefathers to inherit.

And I said: How shall I place you among the sons? But I will give you a desirable land, an inheritance of the beauty of Hosts of nations, and I said: Call Me 'my Father,' and do not turn away from following Me.
Truly, as a woman betrays her beloved, so have you betrayed Me, O house of Yisroel, Havayah says.
A voice on the rivulets is heard, the weeping of the supplications of the children of Yisroel, for they perverted their way, they forgot Havayah their Elokim.
Return, backsliding children, I will cure your backslidings. "Here we are; we have come to You, for You are Havayah our Elokim.
Truly, in vain we awaited help from the hills, the multitude of mountains, but in Havayah our Elokim is Yisroel's salvation.
But the shameful thing has consumed the toil of our fathers since our youth, their flocks and their cattle, their sons and their daughters.

We lie in our shame, and our disgrace covers us, for we have sinned against Havayah our Elokim — we and our fathers — since our youth until this day, but we did not hearken to the voice of Havayah our Elokim."
If you return, O Yisroel, Havayah says, to Me, you shall return, and if you remove your detestable things from My Presence, you shall not wander.
And you will swear, "As Havayah lives," in truth and in justice and in righteousness, nations will bless themselves with him and boast about him.
For so Havayah said to the people of Yehudah and to Yerushalayim: Plow for yourself a furrow, and do not sow upon thorns.

Circumcise yourselves to Havayah and remove the foreskins of your heart, O people of Yehudah and dwellers of Yerushalayim, lest My anger go forth and burn with none to quench it because of the evil of your deeds.
Tell in Yehudah and in Yerushalayim; let it be heard and say, "Sound a shofar in the land"; cry out, assemble, and say, "Gather, and let us come into the fortified cities."
Raise a standard to Tziyon, assemble, do not stand, for I am bringing evil from the north, and a great destruction.
A lion has come up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations has traveled, has come forth from his place, to make your land into a waste, your cities will be desolate without an inhabitant.
Because of this, gird yourselves with sackcloth, lament and wail, for the fierce anger of Havayah has not turned back from us.
And it shall be on that day, Havayah says, the heart of the king and the heart of the princes shall fail, and the priests shall be astonished and the prophets shall wonder.
And I said, "Ah, O Havayah Elokim! You have surely misled this people and Yerushalayim, saying, 'You will have peace,' yet the sword has reached the soul."
At that time it shall be said of this people: A wind has swept the rivulets in the desert on the way of the daughter of My people, not to winnow and not to cleanse.
A full spirit of these shall come to me; now, I too will debate with them.
Behold, like clouds he will ascend, and like the whirlwind his chariots; his steeds are swifter than eagles; woe is to us for we have been plundered.
Cleanse your heart of evil, O Yerushalayim, in order that you be saved; how long will you lodge in your midst your iniquitous thoughts?
For a voice proclaims from Dan and announces calamity from Mount. Efraim.
Mention on behalf of the nations, behold, announce concerning Yerushalayim, besiegers are coming from a distant land, and they have given out their voice against the cities of Yehudah.
Like watchers of a field they are against her round about, for she has rebelled against Me, Havayah says.
Your way and your deeds have done these to you. This is because of your evil that it is bitter, that it has reached to your heart.
My bowels, my bowels! I writhe in pain. The walls of my heart! My heart stirs within me. I cannot be silent, for you, my soul, have heard the sound of the shofar, the alarm of war.
Destruction upon destruction has occurred, for the entire land has been plundered; suddenly my tents have been plundered, in a moment my curtains.
How long will I see the standard, will I hear the sound of the shofar?
For My people are foolish, they know Me not; they are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are wise to do evil, but they know not to do good.
I saw the earth, and behold, it was void and unformed, and the heavens, and they had no light.
I saw the mountains, and behold, they were quaking, and all the hills moved to and fro.
I saw, and behold, there were no people, and all the fowl of the heavens wandered away.
I saw, and behold, the fruitful field became a desert, and all its cities were destroyed because of Havayah, because of His fierce anger.
For so Havayah says: All the land shall be a desolation, but I will not make an end.
For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above shall darken, for that which I spoke as I had planned, I did not regret and I will not turn back from it.
From the voice of the riders and the archers, the entire city they came into the thickets, and they ascended among the boulders; every city is deserted, and no people are living in them.

And you, despoiled one, what can you do that you wear crimson, that you adorn yourself with golden ornaments, that you enlarge your eye with paint? In vain you beautify yourself; lovers despise you, they seek your life.

For a voice like that of a travailing woman I heard, in pain as a woman bearing her first child, the voice of the daughter of Tziyon who will wail, will break her hands. "Woe is to me, for my soul is faint before the murderers."
Stroll in the streets of Yerushalayim, and see now and know, and seek in its squares, whether you will find a man, whether there is one who performs justice, who seeks faith, and I will forgive her.
And if they say, "As Havayah lives," they, nevertheless, will swear falsely.

O Havayah, are not Your eyes upon faith? You smote them but they felt no pain, You consumed them, but they refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock, they have refused to repent.
And I said, "But they are poor, they have become foolish, for they did not know the way of Havayah, the judgment of their Elokim.
I will go to the great ones and speak with them, for they know the way of Havayah, the judgment of their Elokim: but they together broke the yoke, burst the bands.

Therefore, a lion from the forest smote them, a wolf of the deserts spoils them, a leopard hastens upon their cities, anyone who comes out of them shall be torn to pieces, for their transgressions are many, their backslidings are increased.
Shall I forgive you for this? Your children have forsaken Me, and they swore by no — gods. Here I sated them and they committed adultery, and they banded together in the house of a harlot.
Like armed stallions, they would arise early; they would neigh, each one over his friend's wife.
Shall I not punish for these things? Havayah says, or for a nation such as this shall My soul not wreak vengeance?
Ascend upon its rows and destroy, but make no complete end; remove its roots, for they are not Havayah's.
For the house of Yisroel and the house of Yehudah have dealt treacherously with Me, Havayah says.
They denied Havayah and said, "It is not He, and no evil will befall us, neither will we see sword or famine.
And the prophets shall become wind, for there is no speech in them." So shall be done to them.
Therefore, so Havayah Elokim of Hosts says, because you have spoken this word. Behold I put My words into your mouth as fire, and this people shall be wood and it shall consume them.

Behold I bring upon you a nation from afar, O house of Yisroel, Havayah says; it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you will not know, and you will not understand what he will speak.
His quiver is like an open grave, all of them are mighty men.

And he will devour your harvest and your bread; they will devour your sons and your daughters; he will devour your flocks and your cattle; he will devour your vines and your fig trees; he will impoverish your fortified cities upon which you rely, with the sword.
And also in those days, Havayah says, I will not make an end to you.

And it will be that you will say, "For what reason has Havayah our Elokim done all these to us?" you shall say to them: As you have forsaken Me and worshipped foreign gods in your land, so shall you serve strangers in a land not yours.
Tell this in the house of Yackov and make it heard in Yehudah, saying:
Hearken to this, foolish people without understanding; they have eyes yet they see not, they have ears yet they hear not.

Will you not fear Me? Havayah says, or, do you not quake from before Me, for I made sand a boundary for the sea, an everlasting ordinance, which it cannot pass, and its waves toss themselves, yet they cannot prevail; and its waves roar, but they do not pass it.
And this people had a revolting and rebellious heart; they turned away and they were gone.
And they did not say in their heart, "Let us now fear Havayah our Elokim, Who gives rain, the early rain and the latter rain in its time, the weeks of the laws of harvest He keeps for us."
Your iniquities have brought these about, and your sins have withheld the good from you.
For wicked men are found in My people; they lie in wait as a trap bites; they station an ambush, they catch people.
As a cage is full, so are their houses full of deceit; therefore, they have become great and they have become rich.

They have become fat, they have become thick; also they transgress in deeds of wickedness; they did not plead the cause of an orphan that they prosper, and the judgment of the poor they did not judge.
Shall I not punish for these? Havayah says, or for such a nation shall My soul not take vengeance?
An appalling and horrible thing has come about in the land.
The prophets have prophesied falsely, and the priests govern after them, and My people love to have it so. Now what shall you do in the end thereof?
Gather the sons of Binyamin from the midst of Yerushalayim, and in Tekoa sound the shofar, and over Beis-Hakerem raise a standard, for evil is visible from the north and a great calamity.
The comely and the delicate one have I destroyed, O daughter of Tziyon.
Shepherds and their flocks shall come to her, they have pitched tents around her, they feed bare, each one in his place.
Prepare war against her, arise and let us go up at noontime; woe is to us for the day has passed, for the shadows of evening are stretched out.
Arise and let us go up at night and let us destroy her palaces.
For so Havayah of Hosts says: Cut the trees and cast on Yerushalayim a siege mound; that is the city whose sins have been visited upon her, everywhere there is oppression in its midst.
As a well lets its water flow, so has she let her evil flow; violence and spoil is heard therein before Me continually; sickness and wounds.
Be corrected, O Yerushalayim, lest My soul be alienated from you; lest I make you a desolation, a land uninhabited.
So Havayah of Hosts says: They shall thoroughly glean like a vine the remnant of Yisroel; return your hand as a vintager over the branches.
To whom shall I speak and warn that they shall hearken? Behold, their ear is clogged, and they cannot listen; behold, the word of Havayah was a disgrace to them, they desire it not.

Therefore, I am full of the fury of Havayah, I am weary of containing it, to pour it out upon the babes in the street and upon the assembly of young men together, for a man with a woman shall be seized, an old man with one full of days.
And their houses shall be turned over to others, fields and wives together, for I will stretch out My hand over the inhabitants of the land, Havayah says.
For, from their smallest to their greatest, they all commit robbery, and from prophet to priest they all deal falsely.
And they healed the breach of My people easily, saying, "Peace, peace," but there is no peace.

They shall be put to shame since they have committed abomination. Neither are they ashamed nor do they know to feel disgrace. They will, therefore, fall among the slain; at the time I have visited upon them, they will stumble, Havayah says.
So Havayah says: stand on the roads and see, and ask of the paths of old, which is the good way, and go on it, and find rest for your soul, and they said, "We will not go."
And I have stationed lookouts over you. Hearken to the sound of the shofar, and they said, "We will not hearken."
Therefore, hearken, O nations, and know, O congregation, what is within them.
Hearken, O earth, behold, I bring evil to this people, the fruit of their thoughts, for they did not hearken to My words, and they rejected My instruction.
Why do I need the frankincense that comes from Sheva, and the good cane from a distant country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasant to Me.
Therefore, so Havayah says: Behold, I give this people stumbling blocks, and both fathers and sons together shall stumble upon them, a neighbor and his companion, and they shall perish.
So Havayah says: Behold, a people is coming from the northland, and a great nation will be aroused from the ends of the earth.
They will grasp bow and spear, they are cruel and have no compassion; their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, equipped like a man for war, upon you, O daughter of Tziyon.
We have heard his report, our hands have become feeble, trouble has grasped us, and pain, as a woman in travail.
Go not forth into the field, and on the road do not go, for the enemy has a sword; there is fear all around.
O daughter of My people, gird yourself with sackcloth and roll in ashes; make yourself a mourning as for an only child, a bitter lamentation, for suddenly the plunderer will come upon us.
I have made you the strong one and the fortress of My people, and you shall know and test their way.
They are all extremely perverse, going tale bearing like copper and iron; they are all destructive.
The bellows is heated from the fire, the lead is consumed; in vain does the founder refine, and the wicked ones have not been separated.
Refuse silver have men called them, for Havayah has rejected them.
The word that came to Yirmiyahu from Havayah, saying:
Stand in the gate of the house of Havayah, and proclaim there this word, and say; Hearken to the word of Havayah, all Yehudah who come into these gates to prostrate yourselves before Havayah.
So Havayah of Hosts said, the Elokim of Yisroel; Improve your ways and your deeds, I will allow you to dwell in this place.
Do not rely on false words, saying: The Temple of Havayah, the Temple of Havayah, the Temple of Havayah are they.
For if you improve your ways and your deeds, if you perform judgment between one man and his fellowman,
if you do not oppress a stranger, an orphan, or a widow, and you do not shed innocent blood in this place, and you do not follow other gods for your detriment,
I will allow you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave your forefathers from days of yore to eternity.
Behold, you rely on false words, of no avail.
Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, offer up to Baal, and follow other gods that you know not,
And will you come and stand before Me in this house, upon which My name is called, and say, "We are saved," in order to commit all these abominations?
Has this house upon which My name is called, become a cave of profligate men in your eyes? I, too, behold I have seen it, Havayah says.
For go now to My place that is in Shiloh, where I caused My name to rest at first, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Yisroel.
And now, because you have committed all these acts, Havayah says, and I spoke to you, going early and speaking, but you did not hearken, and I called you, but you did not respond.
And I will do to the house upon which My name is called, upon which you rely, and to the place that I gave you and your forefathers, as I did to Shiloh.
And I will cast you away from My presence as I cast all your brothers, all the seed of Efraim.
And you, pray not on behalf of this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer, and entreat Me not for I will not hear you.
Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Yehudah and in the streets of Yerushalayim?

The sons are gathering wood, the fathers are kindling fire, and the women are kneading dough to make starshaped cakes for the queen of the heaven and to pour libations to other gods, in order to provoke Me.
Are they provoking Me? Havayah says. Are they not provoking themselves for the shame of their faces?

Therefore, so Havayah Elokim says: Behold, My wrath and My fury reaches this place, upon man and upon beast, upon the trees of the field and upon the produce of the soil, and it shall burn and not be quenched.
So Havayah of Hosts says, the Elokim of Yisroel; Add your burnt offerings upon your sacrifices and eat flesh.
For neither did I speak with your forefathers nor did I command them on the day I brought them out of the land of Mitzrayim, concerning a burnt offering or a sacrifice.
But this thing did I command them, saying: Obey Me so that I am your Elokim and you are My people, and you walk in all the ways that I command you, so that it may be well with you.
But they did not obey nor did they incline their ear, but walked according to their own counsels and in the view of their evil heart, and they went backwards and not forwards.
Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Mitzrayim until this day, I sent you all My servants the prophets, sending them day after day with every fresh morn.
Yet they hearkened not to Me nor did they incline their ear, but stiffened their necks; they did worse than their fathers.
And when you will speak all of these words to them and they will not hearken to you, and you call out to them and they will not answer you,
Then say to them: This is the nation that did not hear the voice of Havayah their Elokim and has not received correction; out of their mouth faithfulness has disappeared, yea rooted out!
So tear off your diadem and cast it off, and let lamentation sound out over the hillocks, for Havayah has rejected and abandoned the generation of His wrath.
For the sons of Yehudah have done what is evil in My eyes, Havayah says; they placed their abominations in the house upon which My name is called, to pollute it.
And they have built the high places of Tofes which are in the valley of Ben-Hinnom, to burn their sons and daughters with fire, which I did not ordain, neither did it enter My mind.

Therefore, behold days are coming, Havayah says, that it shall no longer be called Tofes or the Valley of the son of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter, and they shall bury in Tofes for lack of room.
And the carcasses of this people shall be for food for the fowl of the heaven and for the beasts of the earth, and no one will frighten them.

And I will stop from the cities of Yehudah and from the streets of Yerushalayim the sound of mirth and the sound of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, for the land shall be desolate.

At that time, Havayah says, they will take out the bones of the kings of Yehudah and the bones of his princes and the bones of the priests and the bones of the prophets and the bones of the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, from their graves.

And spread them before the sun and before the moon and before the entire host of the heavens, which they loved and which they worshipped and which they followed, and which they sought and to which they prostrated themselves; they shall neither be gathered nor be buried; they shall be for dung on the surface of the earth.
And death shall be preferable to life for all the residue that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have cast them out, Havayah of Hosts says.
And you shall say to them; so Havayah says: Shall they fall and not rise, if he repents, will He not return?
Why has this people, Yerushalayim, slid back a perpetual backsliding? They have held on to deceit, they refuse to repent.
I hearkened and heard, they do not speak properly; no man regrets his wickedness, saying, "What have I done?" Each one turns away in his course, as a frightening horse into battle.
Even the stork in the heaven knows her seasons, and the turtledoves and the crane and the swallow await the time of their coming, but My people do not know the ordinance of Havayah.
How do you say, "We are wise, and the Law of Havayah is with us"? Verily, behold it is in vain, he made a false scribes' pen.
Wise men were ashamed, they were broken and caught; behold they rejected the word of Havayah, now what wisdom have they?
Therefore, I will give their wives to others, their fields to those who possess them for from the smallest to the greatest, they all commit robbery, from prophet to priest, they all deal falsely.
And they healed the breach of My people easily, saying, "Peace, peace," but there is no peace.

They shall be put to shame since they have committed abomination. Neither are they ashamed nor do they know to feel disgrace. They will, therefore, fall among the slain; at the time I have visited upon them, they will stumble, Havayah says.
I will utterly consume them, Havayah says. There shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree; even the leaves will be withered, for what I gave them they transgressed.

Why do we sit still? Gather together, and let us go to the fortified cities, and there let us sit in silence, for Havayah our Elokim has silenced us, and has given us poisoned water to drink because we have sinned against Havayah.
We hoped for peace, but no good came; for a time of healing, but behold, terror.

From Dan is heard the snorting of their horses, at the sound of the neighing of their stallions the whole land quakes; they come and devour the land and its produce, the city and those that dwell therein.
For behold, I am sending you serpents, adders which cannot be charmed, and they shall bite you, Havayah says.
Were I to suppress my grief, my heart is sick within me.

Hark the voice from a distant land, the cry of the daughter of My people; is Havayah not in Tziyon? Is not her King therein? Why have they provoked Me with their graven images, with their strange vanities?
The harvest is past, the summer is ended; and we are not saved.
For the wound of the daughter of my people, I am wounded (with grief); I mourn, (and) dismay has taken hold of me.
Is there no balm in Gilad? Is there no physician there? Why then, has the health of the daughter of my people not been restored?
O that my head were (full of) waters and my eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people.
O that I had in the desert a wayfarers' lodging-place, that I might leave my people and go away from them! For they are all adulterers, a company of traitors!

They have directed their tongue treacherously (as) their bows, and they have grown strong in the land not for the sake of truth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not know Me, Havayah says.
Let each one beware of his neighbor, and do not trust any brother; for each brother forges plans, and every neighbor spreads slander.
Indeed, they deceive one another and do not speak the truth; they have taught their tongue to speak lies, they commit iniquity (until) they are weary.
Your habitation is in the midst of deceit; because of deceit they refuse to know Me, Havayah says.
Therefore, thus Havayah of Hosts says, I will refine them and test them, for what else can I do because of (the wickedness of) the daughter of My people?
Their tongue is a deadly arrow, it speaks deceit; each one speaks peaceably with his mouth to his neighbor, but in his heart he lays a trap for him.
Shall I not punish them for these things, Havayah says, shall I not avenge Myself on a nation such as this?

I will take up weeping and wailing for the mountains, and a lamentation for the dwellings of the wilderness, because they are withered and without any one passing through, and the lowing of the cattle is not heard; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast have fled and are gone.
And I will make Yerushalayim heaps (of ruin), a lair of jackals; and I will make the cities of Yehudah a desolation, without inhabitant.

Who is the man so wise that he can understand this? And who is he to whom the mouth of Havayah has spoken, that he may declare it? Why is the land ruined (and) withered like a wilderness, without anyone passing through?
And Havayah said: (It is) because they have forsaken My Law, which I set before them, and have not hearkened to My voice, nor walked by it.
But they have followed the view of their own heart, and after the Bealim, which their fathers taught them (to worship).
Therefore, so thus Havayah of Hosts said, the Elokim of Yisroel; Behold, I will feed them — this people — with wormwood, and will give them poisonous water to drink.
I will scatter them among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known; and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.
Thus Havayah of Hosts said: Consider and call for the (hired) women mourners that they may come; and send for the skillful women, and let them come.
O let them make haste and raise a wailing over us, so that our eyes may shed tears, and our eyelids gush with water.
For a sound of wailing is heard from Tziyon: 'O how we are ruined! We are very much ashamed, because we have left the land, because they have cast down our dwellings!'
Indeed hear, O women, the word of Havayah, and let your ear receive the word of His mouth; teach your daughters a lamentation, and each to her neighbor a dirge.
For death has penetrated our windows, it has entered our palaces; to cut off the infants from the streets, and the young men from the squares.
Speak; Thus Havayah says: Indeed, the carcasses of men shall fall like dung on the open field, and like sheaves after the reaper, with none to gather them!
Thus Havayah says: Let not the wise man boast of his wisdom, nor the strong man boast of his strength, nor the rich man boast of his riches.
But let him that boasts exult in this, that he understands and knows me, for I am Havayah Who practices kindness, justice and righteousness on the earth; for in these things I delight, Havayah says.
Behold, days are coming, Havayah says, when I will punish every circumcised one with his uncircumcision.

Mitzrayim, Yehudah, Edom, the children of Ammon, Moav, and all those cast off to the corners, who dwell in the desert, for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Yisroel are of uncircumcised hearts.
Hearken to the word that Havayah spoke about you, O house of Yisroel.
So Havayah says: of the way of the nations you shall not learn, and from the signs of the heaven be not dismayed, for the nations are dismayed from them.
For the statutes of the peoples are vanity, for it is but a stock that one cut from the forest, the handiwork of a carpenter with a small axe.
With silver and gold he beautifies it, with nails and with sledge hammers they strengthen them so that it does not bend.
Like a palm tree they are beaten, and they do not speak; they are carried for they do not step; fear them not for they will do no harm, neither is it in them to do good.
There is none like You, O Havayah; You are great, and Your name is great with might.
Who will not fear You, O King of the nations, for it befits You, for among all the wise men of the nations and among all their kingdom there is none like You.
But with one thing they are brutish and foolish, the vanities for which they will be punished are but wood.
Silver beaten into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Ufaz, the work of a craftsman and the hands of a smith; their raiment is blue and purple, all of them the work of experts.
But Havayah Elokim is true; He is a living Elokim and the King of the world; from His anger the earth quakes, and the nations cannot contain His fury.
So shall you say to them, "The gods who did not make the heavens and the earth, shall perish from the earth and from beneath these heavens.
Who made the earth with His strength, He prepared the world by His wisdom, and with His understanding He stretched out the heavens.
At the sound of His giving a multitude of waters in the heaven, and He brought up clouds from the end of the earth, He made lightning for the rain, and He took wind out of His treasuries.
Every man is brutish without knowledge; every smith is put to shame by his graven image, for his molten images are false, without spirit in them.
They are vanity, a work of delusion; at the time of their visitation they shall perish.
Not like these is Yackov's portion, for He is the One Who formed everything, and Yisroel is the tribe of His inheritance; Havayah of Hosts is His name."
Gather in from the land your merchandise, you who sit in the fortified cities.
For, so Havayah says: Behold, I will sling the inhabitants of the land this time, and I will bring troubles to them that they may find.
Woe is to me for my hurt, my wound is grievous, and I said, "This is but an illness, and I will bear it."
My tent has been spoiled, and all my cords have been broken; my children have left me and they are not here. No one pitches my tent anymore, or sets up my curtains.
For the shepherds have become brutish, and they did not seek Havayah: therefore, they have not prospered, and all their flocks have been scattered.
Hark! A report, behold it comes, and a great tumult from the northland, to make the cities of Yehudah a desolation, a lair of jackals.
I know, O Havayah, that man's way is not his; neither has the man who goes, to prepare his step.
Chasten me, O Havayah, but with a measure, not with Your wrath, lest You diminish me.

Pour out Your wrath upon the nations that do not know You and upon the families that have not called in Your name, for they have devoured Yackov and consumed him and destroyed him, and have wasted his dwelling.
The word that came to Yirmiyahu from Havayah, to say;
Hearken to the words of this covenant, and you shall speak to the men of Yehudah and to the inhabitants of Yerushalayim.
And you shall say to them, so Havayah Elokim said of Yisroel; Cursed be the man who will not hearken to the words of this covenant,

Which I commanded your forefathers on the day I took them out of the land of Mitzrayim, out of the iron furnace, saying: Hearken to My voice and do them, according to all that I will command you, and you shall be to Me for a people, and I will be to you for a Elokim.
In order to establish the oath that I swore to your forefathers to give them a land flowing with milk and honey as of this day. And I replied and said, "Amen, O Havayah."
And Havayah said to me; Proclaim all these words in the cities of Yehudah and in the streets of Yerushalayim, saying: Hearken to the words of this covenant and you shall do them.
For I warned your forefathers on the day I brought them up from the land of Mitzrayim until this day, warning early every morning, saying: Hearken to My voice.

But they did not hearken, neither did they bend their ears, and they went, each man according to the view of his evil heart, and I brought upon them all the words of this covenant that I commanded to do, and they did not do.
And Havayah said to me; A conspiracy has been found among the men of Yehudah, and among the inhabitants of Yerushalayim.

They have returned to the iniquities of their first forefathers, who refused to hearken to My words, and they followed other gods to worship them; the house of Yisroel and the house of Yehudah broke My covenant that I made with their forefathers.
Therefore, so Havayah says: Behold, I bring upon them evil which they shall be unable to escape, and, although they shall cry out to Me, I will not heed them.
And they shall go from the cities of Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense, and they shall not save them at the time of their misfortune.
For as many as your cities were your gods, O Yehudah, and as many as the streets of Yerushalayim you have made altars for the shameful thing, altars to burn incense for the Baal.
And you, do not pray for this people, neither shall you lift up cry nor prayer, for I do not hearken at the time they call out to Me because of their misfortune.
What has My beloved to do in My house, seeing that the many perform evil design, and the holy flesh they remove from you, for with your evil then you rejoice.
A leafy olive-tree fair with goodly fruit, has Havayah called your name; to the sound of a great tumult, He has kindled fire upon it, and they have broken its branches.
And Havayah of Hosts Who planted you spoke evil concerning you, about the evil of the house of Yisroel and the house of Yehudah, which they did to them to provoke Me, to burn sacrifices to Baal.
And Havayah let me know, and I knew, then You showed me their deeds.

And I was like a lamb and a bull, that is brought to the slaughter, and I did not know that they had devised plans about me, "Let us destroy his food with wood, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, and let his name no longer be remembered."
And Havayah of Hosts is a just Judge, Who searches the kidneys and the heart, "Let me see Your vengeance against them, for to You, I have revealed my cause.
Therefore, so Havayah of Hosts says concerning the men of Anatot, who seek your life, saying, "You shall not prophesy in the name of Havayah, and you shall not die by our hand."
Therefore, so Havayah of Hosts says: Behold, I will visit retribution upon them; the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and daughters shall die through hunger.
And they shall have no remnant, for I will bring misfortune upon the men of Anatot in the year of their remembrance.
You are right, O Havayah, when I contend with You, but I will argue with You. Why has the way of the wicked prospered, all who deal with treachery have peace?
You have planted them, they have even taken root, they have even produced fruit. You are near in their mouths but far from their thoughts.
But You, O Havayah, have known me, You see me, and You try my heart with You. Draw them out like sheep to the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
How long will the land mourn and the grass of all the field dry out? " Because of the evil of its inhabitants, beasts and fowl are ended, for they said, "He will not see our end."
For if you have run with footmen and they wearied you, how will you compete with horses, and in the peaceful land which you trust, how will you do in the heights of the Yarden?
For, even your brethren, and your father's household, they too have dealt treacherously with you, they too have called a gang after you; do not believe them although they speak cordially to you.
I have abandoned My House, I have forsaken My inheritance; I have delivered My soul's beloved into the hand of her enemies.
My inheritance was to Me like a lion in the forest; she raised her voice against Me; therefore, I hated her.
Is My inheritance to Me a speckled bird of prey? Are there birds of prey around her? Go, gather all the beasts of the field; come to eat.
Many shepherds have destroyed My vineyard, they have trampled My field; they have made My delightful field into a desert waste.
He has made it a waste; the wasted one mourns before Me; the entire land is waste because no one lays it to his heart.
On all the rivulets in the pastureland have plunderers come, for the sword of Havayah consumes from one end of the land to the other end of the land; there is no peace for any flesh.
They sowed wheat, but they reaped thorns; they have become ill to no avail. Be ashamed of your increase, because of the fierce anger of Havayah.

So Havayah says: Concerning all My wicked neighbors who touch the inheritance that I have given My nation, Yisroel, to inherit, behold I uproot them from upon their land, and the house of Yehudah I will uproot from their midst.
And it shall come to pass, that after I uproot them, I will return and have pity on them, and I will restore them, each one to his inheritance and each one to his land.
And it shall be, if they learn the ways of My people to swear by My name, "As Havayah lives," as they taught My people to swear by Baal, they shall be built up in the midst of My people.
And if they do not heed, I shall uproot that nation, uprooting and destroying, Havayah says.
So Havayah said to me; Go and buy yourself a linen girdle and put it on your loins, and do not put it in water.
And I bought the girdle according to the word of Havayah, and I put it on my loins.
And the word of Havayah came to me a second time, saying:
Take the girdle that you bought and rise, go to Peras and hide it there in the cleft of a rock.
And I went and hid it in Peras, as Havayah had commanded me.
And it came to pass at the end of many days, that Havayah said to me; Arise, go to Peras and take from there the girdle which I commanded you to hide there.
And I went to Peras, and I dug and took the girdle from the place where I had hidden it, and behold, the girdle was rotten; it was of no use for anything.
And the word of Havayah came to me, saying:
So Havayah said: So will I destroy the pride of Yehudah and the great pride of Yerushalayim.

This evil people, who refuse to hearken to My words, who follow the view of their heart, and they followed other gods to worship them and to prostrate themselves to them; and it shall be like this girdle, which is of no use for anything.

For, just as the girdle clings to a man's loins, so have I caused the entire house of Yisroel and the entire house of Yehudah to cling to Me, Havayah says, to be My people, and for a name and for praise and for glory, but they did not hearken.
And you shall say this word to them: So Havayah Elokim said of Yisroel; Every bottle will be filled with wine. And they will say to you, "Do we not know that every bottle is filled with wine?"

And you shall say to them: So Havayah said: Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land and the kings who sit upon Dovid's throne, and the priests and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Yerushalayim with drunkenness.
And I will dash them one against the other, and the fathers and the sons together, Havayah says. I will neither pity, nor will I spare, nor will I have compassion not to destroy them.
Hearken and give ear, do not be proud, for Havayah has spoken.

Give Havayah your Elokim honor before it becomes dark, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and you shall hope for light, but He will make it into darkness, and making it into a thick cloud.
And if you do not hearken to it, in secret my soul will weep because of your pride and my eye shall weep sore and run down with tears, for Havayah's flock has been captured.
Say to the king and to the queen-mother, "Sit in a low place, for your greatness has come down, the crown of your glory."
The cities of the South are shut up and there is none to open them; all of Yehudah has been exiled, she was exiled peacefully.
Lift your eyes and see those coming from the North. Where is the flock that was given you, the sheep of your glory?
What will you say when He visits upon you, when you accustomed them to be princes over you at your head? Will not pangs seize you like a woman in confinement?
And if you say in your heart, "Why have these befallen me? For the greatness of your iniquity were your skirts uncovered, your steps cut off.
Will a Kushi change his skin, or a leopard his spots? So will you be able to improve, you who have become accustomed to do evil.
And I will scatter them like straw that passes with the wind, to the desert.
This is your lot, the portion of your measures, from Me, Havayah says, for you have forgotten Me, and you have trusted in falsehood.
And I also have uncovered your skirts over your face, and your disgrace has been seen.

Your adulteries and your neighings, and the thoughts of your harlotry; on hills in the field have I seen your abominations; woe to you, Yerushalayim, you shall not become purified. After when shall it ever be?
The word of Havayah that came to Yirmiyahu concerning the droughts.
Yehudah mourns, and her cities are cut off; they have become blackened to the ground, and the cry of Yerushalayim has risen.

And their mighty ones have sent their youths for water. They have come upon pits and have found no water; their vessels have returned empty; they have been ashamed and confounded and have covered their heads.
Because the earth was broken for there was no rain on the earth, farmers were ashamed; they covered their heads.
For also the hind in the field has borne and abandoned, for there was no grass.
And wild donkeys stood by the rivulets, they gasped for air like jackals, their eyes failed for there is no herbage.
If our iniquities have testified against us, O Havayah, do for Your name's sake, for our backslidings have increased; we have sinned to You.
O hope of Yisroel, his Savior at time of trouble, why should you be like a stranger in the land, and like a wayfarer who turns aside to lodge?
Why should You be like a man overcome, like a mighty man, unable to save? For You are in our midst, O Havayah, and Your name is called upon us; forsake us not.

So Havayah says to this people; So have they loved to wander, they have not kept their feet back; therefore, Havayah did not accept them; now He will remember their iniquity and visit their sins upon them.
And Havayah said to me; Do not pray for this people for good.

If they fast, I will not hearken to their prayer, and if they offer up a burnt offering or a meal offering, I do not accept them, but I will utterly destroy them with the sword and with famine and with pestilence.
And I said, "Ah, O Havayah Elokim, behold the prophets say to them, 'You will see no sword, neither will you have a famine, I will give you a true peace in this place.

And Havayah said to me; The prophets are prophesying lies in My name; I did not send them neither did I command them, nor did I speak to them. A false vision, divination, a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart they prophesy to you.

Therefore, so Havayah says concerning the prophets who prophesy in My name although I have not sent them, and they say, "Sword and famine shall not be in this land." Those prophets shall perish by the sword and the famine.

And the people to which they prophesy, shall be cast in the streets of Yerushalayim because of the famine and the sword, and no one will bury them, they, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, and I will pour out upon them their evil.
And you shall say this word to them: May my eyes run down with tears day and night and not be silent, for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, a very grievous blow.

If I go out to the field, behold the slain of the sword, and if I go into the city, behold those ill with famine, for even the prophet and even the priest have gone around to a land which they had not known.

Have You indeed rejected Yehudah? Has Your soul despised Tziyon? Why have You smitten us and we have no cure? We hope for peace, but there is no good, and for a time of healing, but behold, there is terror.
We know, O Havayah, our wickedness, the iniquity of our forefathers, for we have sinned to You.
Do not condemn us for Your name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of Your glory. Remember, do not break Your covenant with us.
Are there among the vanities of the nations those who give rain? Does the heaven give raindrops? Is it not You, O Havayah our Elokim? Now let us hope for You, for You have done all these.
And Havayah said to me; If Moshe and Shmuel stand before Me, I have no desire for this people, send them away from before My face and let them go forth.

And it shall be if they say to you, "Where shall we go?" you shall say to them, "So Havayah said: Such as are for death, to death, and such as are for the sword, to the sword, and such as are for famine, to famine, and such as are for captivity, to captivity."
And I will appoint over them four families, Havayah says, the sword to slay and the dogs to drag and the fowl of the heaven and the beasts of the earth to devour and to destroy.
And I will make them a horror to all the kingdom of the earth because of Menasheh the son of Chizkiyahu, king of Yehudah, for all that he did in Yerushalayim.
For, who will have pity on you, O Yerushalayim, and who will lament over you, and who will turn aside to ask of your welfare?
You have forsaken Me, Havayah says. You shall go backwards, and I have stretched out My hand over you and destroyed you. I am weary of repenting.
And I winnowed them with a sieve in the cities of the earth; I bereft, I destroyed My people; they have not returned from their ways.
His widows are to Me more numerous than the sand of the seas; I have brought to them upon the mother a chosen one who will rob them at midday; I have cast upon her suddenly a city and terrors.

She who bore seven has been cut off, her soul grieves, her sun sets when it is still day. She is ashamed and confounded. And her remnant I shall deliver to the sword before their enemies, Havayah says.
Woe is to me, my mother, that you bore me, a man of quarrel and a man of contention to the whole land. I have not lent, nor have they lent to me. Yet, they all curse me.
Havayah said: Verily, I will leave you over for good; verily I will cause them to beg you in time of famine and in time of distress, with the enemy.
Will iron break iron from the north and copper?
Your riches and your treasures I will give for plunder, not for a price, and for all your sins and throughout all your boundaries.
And I will cause you to pass over to your enemies in a land that you do not know, for a fire burns in My nostril; it shall be kindled against you.
You know, O Havayah, remember me and think of me, and avenge me of my pursuers. Take me not to Your long suffering, know, I bore disgrace for Your sake.
Your words were found and I ate them, and Your word was to me a joy and a rejoicing of my heart, for Your name was called upon me, O Havayah Elokim of Hosts.
I did not sit in the council of merrymakers, nor did I rejoice; because of Your hand I sat in seclusion, for You filled me with fury.
Why was my pain perpetual, and my wound grievous? It has refused to heal; you are to me as a failing spring, water that is not faithful.

Therefore, so Havayah said: If you return, I will return you, you will stand before Me, and if you take the precious out of the vile, you shall be as My mouth. Let them return to you, but you shall not return to them.

And I will make you for this nation into a fortified copper wall, and they shall fight against you but they shall not prevail against you, for I am with you to redeem you and to save you, Havayah says.
And I will save you from the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you from the hand of the terrible.
And the word of Havayah came to me saying:
You shall take no wife, and you shall have no sons or daughters in this place.
For so Havayah said regarding the sons and the daughters born in this place and regarding their mothers who bear them and their fathers who beget them in this land.

Deaths of sicknesses shall they die; they shall neither be lamented nor buried; they shall be as dung on the face of the ground, and with the sword and with famine shall they perish, and their carcasses shall be for food for the fowl of the heaven and for the beasts of the earth.
For so Havayah said: Do not go into a house of mourning, neither go to lament, nor bemoan them, for I have gathered in My peace from this people, Havayah says, the lovingkindness and the mercies.
And large and small shall die in this land, they shall not be buried, and men shall not lament for them and they shall not cut their flesh, nor shall they tear their hair for them.
And they shall not break bread for them in mourning, to console him for the dead, neither will they give them to drink a cup of consolation for his father or for his mother.
And to a house of feasting you shall not go to sit with them, to eat and to drink.

For so Havayah of Hosts said, the Elokim of Yisroel; Behold, I will cut off from this place in your presence and in your days a voice of mirth and a voice of gladness, a voice of a bridegroom, and a voice of a bride.

And it shall be, that you shall tell this people all these things, and they shall say to you, "For what did Havayah speak about us all this great evil, and what is our iniquity and what is our sin that we have sinned to Havayah our Elokim?"

And you shall say to them, "Because your fathers have forsaken Me, Havayah says, and they followed other gods and worshipped them and prostrated themselves before them, but they forsook Me, and did not keep My Torah.
And you have done worse than your fathers, and behold, you are going, each one after the view of his evil heart, not to hearken to Me.
And I will cast you off this land to a land that you and your fathers did not know, and you shall serve there other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.
Therefore, behold days are coming, Havayah says, and it shall no longer be said, "As Havayah lives, Who brought up the children of Yisroel from the land of Mitzrayim,"

But, "As Havayah lives, Who brought up the children of Yisroel from the northland and from all the lands where He had driven them," and I will restore them to their land that I gave to their forefathers.

Behold I will send for many fishers, Havayah says, and they will fish them, and afterwards I will send to many hunters and they will hunt them from upon every mountain and upon every hill, and from the clefts of the rocks.
For My eyes are on all their ways, they were not hidden from before Me, neither was their iniquity hidden from before My eyes.
And I will pay first the doubling of their iniquity and their sin, for their profaning My land; with the carcass of their detestable things and their abominations they filled My heritage.

O Havayah, Who are my power and my strength and my refuge in the day of trouble, to You nations will come from the ends of the earth and say, "Only lies have our fathers handed down to us, emptiness in which there is nothing of any avail!
Can a man make gods for himself, and they are no gods?"
Therefore, behold I let them know; at this time I will let them know My power and My might, and they shall know that My Name is Havayah.
The sin of Yehudah is written with a pen of iron, with a diamond point, engraved on the tablet of their heart and on the horns of your altars.
As they remember their children, so do they remember their altars, and their asherim by the green trees upon the high hillocks.
You, who sit upon the mountain in the field, I will give your substance, all your treasures for a spoil! Your high places are made for sin within all your borders.

And you shall release, and I will avenge Myself of you because of your heritage that I gave you, and I will make you serve your enemies in the land that you did not know, for you have kindled fire in My nostrils that shall burn forever.
So Havayah says: Cursed is the man who trusts in man and makes flesh his arm, and whose heart turns away from Havayah.
He shall be like a lone tree in the plain, and will not see when good comes, and will dwell on parched land in the desert, on salt — sodden soil that is not habitable.
Blessed is the man who trusts in Havayah; Havayah shall be his trust.

For he shall be like a tree planted by the water, and by a rivulet spreads its roots, and will not see when heat comes, and its leaves shall be green, and in the year of drought will not be anxious, neither shall it cease from bearing fruit.
The heart is deceitful above all things, and when it is sick, who will recognize it?
I, Havayah, search the heart, test the kidneys, to give everyone according to his ways, according to the fruit of his deeds.
The cuckoo calls but has not laid, so it is he who gathers riches but not by right; he shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end he stands dishonored.
As a Throne of Glory, exalted from the beginning, so is the place of our Sanctuary.

The Havayah who is the source of the hopes of Yisroel, all that forsake You shall be shamed, and they who turn away from me shall be marked out on the earth that they have forsaken the source of living waters, Havayah.
Heal me, O Havayah, then shall I be healed; help me, then I shall be helped, for You are my praise!
Behold, they say to me, "Where is the word of Havayah? Let it come now."
But I did not hasten since I was a shepherd after You, and I did not desire the woeful day, You know it. What came out of my lips was before Your face.
Let it not be to me for a ruin; You are my shelter on a day of evil.
May my pursuers be shamed, but let me not be shamed; may they be broken, but let me not be broken; bring upon them a day of evil, and with a second destruction destroy them.
So Havayah said to me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, in which the kings of Yehudah come, and out of which they go, and in all the gates of Yerushalayim.
And you shall say to them: Hearken to the word of Havayah, O kings of Yehudah and all of Yehudah and all the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, who come into these gates.
So Havayah said: Beware for your souls and carry no burden on the Shabbos day, nor bring into the gates of Yerushalayim.
Neither shall you take a burden out of your houses on the Shabbos day nor shall you perform any labor, and you shall hallow the Shabbos day as I commanded your forefathers.
But they did not hearken, neither did they bend their ears, and they hardened their nape not to hearken and not to receive instruction.
And it shall be if you hearken to Me, Havayah says, not to bring any burden into the gates of this city on the Shabbos day and to hallow the Shabbos day not to perform any labor thereon,

Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on Dovid's throne, riding in chariots and with horses, they and their princes, the men of Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, and this city shall be inhabited forever.

And they shall come from the cities of Yehudah and from the environs of Yerushalayim and from the land of Binyamin and from the lowland and from the mountain and from the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices and meal-offerings and frankincense, and those bringing thanksgiving offerings to the house of Havayah.

And if you will not hearken to Me to hallow the Shabbos day and not to carry burdens and to come into the gates of Yerushalayim on the Shabbos, I will kindle a fire in her gates, and it will consume the palaces of Yerushalayim, and it will not be quenched.
The word that came to Yirmiyahu from Havayah, saying:
Rise and go down to the house of the potter, and there I will let you hear My words.
So I went to the house of the potter, and behold, he was doing work on the wheels.
And the vessel that he was making of clay was spoiled in the potter's hand, and he made it again another vessel, as it had pleased the potter to make.
And the word of Havayah came to me, saying:
As this potter can I not do to you, O house of Yisroel? Havayah says. Behold, as clay in the potter's hand, so are you in My hand, O house of Yisroel.
One instant I may speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to uproot and to demolish and to destroy.
And when that nation repents of its evil for which I spoke concerning it, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to it.
And at one instant I may speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant,
And it will do what is evil in My eyes, not to hearken to My voice, I will repent of the good I said to benefit it.

And now, say now to the men of Yehudah and to the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, saying, So Havayah said: Behold I am devising evil upon you, and I am laying plans against you. Return now, each one from his evil way and improve your ways and your deeds.
But they shall say, "We despair, but after our thoughts we will go, and we will do each one the view of his evil heart.
Therefore, so Havayah said: Ask now among the nations, who heard of anything like these? The virgin of Yisroel committed a very disgraceful thing.
Shall one abandon water flowing from rocks of the field that comes from the snow of Levanon? Shall strange cold flowing water be abandoned?
For My people have forgotten Me; they burn incense to vanity; and the ancient paths caused them to stumble in their ways, to walk in paths, on a way that is not trodden.
To make their land waste, a perpetual hissing, everyone who passes it will be astonished and shake his head.
Like an east wind I will scatter them before the enemy; I will look upon their back and not their face on the day of their misfortune.

And they said, "Come, let us devise plots against Yirmiyahu, for the Torah shall not be lost from the priest, neither counsel from the wise man, nor speech from the prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not listen to all his words."
Hearken, O Havayah, to me, and hear the voice of those who quarrel with me.
Shall evil be paid instead of good, for they have dug a pit for my life. Remember when I stood before You to speak good for them, to bring back Your wrath from them.

Therefore, deliver their children to the famine and spill their blood by the sword, and let their wives be bereaved and widows, and their husbands slain by death, their youths struck by the sword in battle.
May an outcry be heard from their houses, for You shall bring a troop upon them suddenly, for they dug a pit to seize me and they hid snares at my feet to trap me.

And You, O Havayah, know all their plan against me for death; do not atone for their iniquity, and let not their sin be erased from before You, and let them be made to stumble before You; at the time of Your anger do it to them.
So Havayah said: Go and buy a potter's earthen jug, and take along some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests.
And you shall go out to the Ben-Hinnom Valley which is at the entrance of the Charsis Gate, and you shall call there the words that I will speak to you.

And you shall say; Hearken to the word of Havayah, O kings of Yehudah and inhabitants of Yerushalayim; so Havayah of Hosts said, the Elokim of Yisroel; Behold I am bringing evil upon this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.

Because they forsook Me and they estranged this place and burnt incense therein to other gods, which they had not known, they, their forefathers, and the kings of Yehudah, and they filled this place with the blood of innocent people.
And they built the high places of Baal to burn their children with fire as burnt offerings to Baal, which I did not command, neither did I speak nor did it enter My mind.
Therefore, behold days are coming, Havayah says, when this place will no longer be called Tofes or Ben-Hinnom Valley, but the Valley of Slaughter.

And I will frustrate the counsel of Yehudah and Yerushalayim in this place, and I will hurl them down by the sword before their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their lives, and I will give their carcasses for food to the fowl of the heavens and to the beasts of the earth.
And I will make this city into a waste and a hissing; everyone who passes by it shall be astonished and hiss concerning all her plagues.

And I will feed them the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and each one will eat the flesh of his friend, in the siege and the straits that their enemies and those who seek their lives will inflict upon them.
And you shall break the jug before the eyes of the men who go with you.

And you shall say to them: so Havayah of Hosts said: so will I break this people and this city, as one breaks the potter's vessel, which can no longer be repaired, and in the Tofes they will bury without place to bury.
So will I do to this place, Havayah says, and to its inhabitants, and to make this city like the Tofes.

And the houses of Yerushalayim and the houses of the kings of Yehudah shall be like the place of the Tofes, the unclean ones, of all the houses on whose roofs they offered up incense to all the host of heaven and poured libations to other gods.
And Yirmiyahu came from the Tofes where Havayah had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the house of Havayah and said to all the people.

So Havayah of Hosts said, the Elokim of Yisroel; Behold, I am bringing upon this city and upon all her cities all this evil that I spoke concerning her, for they stiffened their necks not to hearken to My words.
And Pashchur son of Immer the priest — he was the chief officer in the house of Havayah — heard Yirmiyahu prophesying these things.
And Pashchur struck Yirmiyahu the prophet and placed him in the prison that is in the upper gate of Binyamin, which is in the house of Havayah.
And it came to pass on the next day that Pashchur released Yirmiyahu from the prison, and Yirmiyahu said to him, "Not Pashchur did Havayah call your name, but Magor Missaviv.

For so Havayah said: Behold I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends, and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies with your eyes seeing, and all of Yehudah I will deliver into the hand of the king of Bavel, and he shall exile them to Bavel and strike them with the sword.

And I will give all the wealth of this city and all her toil and all her precious things, and all the treasures of the kings of Yehudah I will deliver into the hand of their enemies, and they shall plunder them and take them and bring them to Bavel.

And you, Pashchur, and all those who dwell in your houses shall go into captivity, and you shall come to Bavel and there you shall die and there you shall be buried, you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied falsely.
You enticed me, O Havayah, and I was enticed, You overcame me and You prevailed. I have become a laughing-stock; everyone mocks me.
For whenever I speak, I cry out; I call out violence and spoil, for the word of Havayah has been scorn and mockery for me all day long.
Should I say; I will not mention Him, and I will no longer speak in His name, it would be in my heart like a burning fire, confined in my bones, and I wearied to contain it but was unable.

For I heard the slander of many, a gathering around; tell and let us tell about him: everyone who was friendly with me awaits my destruction. Perhaps he will be enticed and we will prevail against him, and we will wreak vengeance upon him.
But Havayah is with me as a mighty warrior. Therefore, my pursuers shall stumble and did not prevail. They were very much ashamed for they not succeed, a perpetual shame that will not be forgotten.
And Havayah of Hosts tests the righteous, He sees the kidneys and the heart. Let me see Your vengeance from them for to You I have revealed my cause.
Sing to Havayah, praise Havayah, for He has saved the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
Cursed be the day in which I was begotten; the day in which my mother bore me shall not be blessed.
Cursed be the man who brought the news to my father, saying, "A male child has been born to you," making him glad.
And that man shall be like the cities that Havayah overturned and did not repent, and let him hear an outcry in the morning and a scream at noontime.
That he did not put me to death from the womb, that my mother should be my grave and her womb a perpetual pregnancy.
Why did I come forth out of the womb to see toil and grief, and my days end with shame?
The word that came to Yirmiyahu from Havayah when King Tzidkiyahu sent him Pashchur son of Malkiyah and Tzefanyah son of Maaseiyah the priest, saying:
Please petition Havayah for us, for Nevuchadretzar king of Bavel is waging war against us; perhaps Havayah will do to us like all His wonders, and he will withdraw from us."
And Yirmiyahu said to them, "So shall you say to Tzidkiyahu,

So Havayah Elokim said of Yisroel; Behold I turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you are waging war against the king of Bavel and against the Kasdim who are besieging you from outside the wall, and I will gather them into this city.
And I will wage war with you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, and with anger and with fury and with great wrath.
And I will smite the inhabitants of this city and the people and the beasts; with a great pestilence they shall die.

And afterwards, Havayah says, I will deliver Tzidkiyahu, the king of Yehudah and his servants and the people and those remaining in this city, from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nevuchadretzar, the king of Bavel and into the hand of your enemies and into the hand of those who seek your lives, and he shall strike them by the edge of the sword; he will not spare them, neither will he pity nor show compassion.
And to this people you shall say; So Havayah said: Behold I place before you the way of life and the way of death.

Whoever abides in this city shall die by the sword or by famine or by pestilence, but whoever goes forth and defects to the Kasdim who are besieging you, shall live, and he will have his life as a prey.
For I have set My anger against this city for evil and not for good, Havayah says; it shall be delivered into the hands of the king of Bavel, and he shall burn it with fire.
And to the house of the king of Yehudah: Hear the word of Havayah.

O house of Dovid, so Havayah said: Execute justice in the morning and rescue the robbed from the hand of the robber, lest My fury go forth like fire, and it burn with no one to extinguish it, because of the evil of your deeds.
Behold I am against you, O dweller of the valley, rock of the plain, Havayah says, those who say, "Who will encamp upon us, and who will come into our dwellings?"
And I will visit upon you according to the fruit of your deeds, Havayah says, and I will ignite a fire in her forest, and it will consume all her surroundings.
So Havayah said: Go down to the house of the king of Yehudah and speak this word there.
And say; Listen to the word of Havayah, O king of Yehudah, who sits on the throne of Dovid, you and your servants and your people who come in these gates.

So Havayah said: Perform justice and charity, and rescue the robbed from the hand of the robber, and to a stranger, an orphan, and a widow do no wrong, do no violence, and shed no innocent blood in this place.
For if you will do this thing, there will come into the gates of this house kings descended from Dovid, sitting on his throne, riding in chariots and with horses, he and his servants and his people.
But if you do not hearken to these words, I swear by Myself, Havayah says, that this house will become a waste.
For so Havayah said concerning the house of the king of Yehudah; You are as Gilad to me, O head of the Levanon, that I will surely make you a desert, cities not inhabited.
And I will prepare for you destroyers, each one with his weapons, and they will cut your choice cedars and cast them upon the fire.
And many nations will pass by this city, and they will say each one to his friend, "For what reason did Havayah do so to this great city?"
And they will say, "Because they forsook the covenant of Havayah their Elokim, and they prostrated themselves to other gods and worshipped them."
Weep not for the dead, neither bemoan him: weep for him who goes away, for he will return no more, nor see his native land.
For so Havayah said concerning Shallum son of Yoshiyahu, king of Yehudah, who ruled instead of Yoshiyahu his father, who left this place; he shall not return there again.
For, in the place where they exiled him, there he will die, and this land he will no longer see.
Woe to him who builds his house without righteousness and his upper chambers without justice, who makes his fellowman work without wages and his hire he does not give him.
Who says, "I will build myself a wide house with spacious upper chambers, and he cuts out windows for himself, and it is ceiled with cedar and painted with vermilion.
Shall you reign, for you compete with the cedar? Your father — did he not eat and drink and perform justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.
He judged the cause of the poor and needy, then it was good. Is not that the knowledge of Me? Havayah says.
For your eyes and your heart are on nothing but your gain and on innocent blood to shed and on the oppression and on the crushing to do.
Therefore, so Havayah said about Yehoyakim, king of Yehudah; They will not lament him, saying, "Hoe, brother!" or "Hoe, sister!" they will not lament him, "Hoe, master!" or "Hoe, his glory!"
A donkey's burial shall he be buried, dragged and tossed past the gates of Yerushalayim.
